name: S&OP Forecast vs Sales -> Google Sheet
_comment: 1. This workflow handles: Forecast vs Sales Report — original forecast, reviewed forecast, actual sales.
3. Replace PASTE_YOUR_SOP_SHEET_ID in both Sheet nodes with the Google Sheet ID
4. The sheet must have a tab named exactly: Forecast
- Django sends large files in chunks of 2,000 rows each.
- First chunk (action='replace'): clears the tab, then appends rows.
- Subsequent chunks (action='append'): appends rows only (no clear).
- The If node routes chunk 0 through Clear, others skip it.
